rules.accepted_credit_types: 50% must be Category 1 (ACCME- or state medical society-accredited, AMA/Board/AOA-approved; AAFP prescribed hours) in the primary area of practice; rest may include ACGME/AOA training, advanced degree study, research, teaching, publications, self-instruction, journal reading, board exam preparation, quality/utilization review committees
rules.alternatives: Extension possible for illness, military service, missionary activity, residence abroad or other extenuating circumstances. An AMA PRA certificate or AOA/state osteopathic CME certificate covering the period is accepted as evidence.
rules.audit_note: Signed certification under penalty of perjury with each annual renewal; the Board may randomly require proof. Keep records 3 years from end of reporting period.

topics.who: All physicians: prescribing of opioids and benzodiazepines, every year, within the 20 hours

rules.notes: One board licenses both MDs and DOs. License fee is paid annually before or during the licensee's birth month; license expires if unpaid by the last day of the birth month.
rules.legal_basis: Arkansas State Medical Board Rule No. 17; Ark. Code Ann. 17-80-104; 17-95-408
rules.new_licensee_rule: Prescribers licensed after December 31, 2015: at least 3 hours of Board-approved prescribing education within the first 2 years of licensure (Rule 2).
